function getCookie(name) {

            if (url) {

                } else {

        }
    })

    }

    /** @type {number} */
    const days = Math.floor((t %= 31536000) / 86400)
    if (days) {
        if (short) {
            parts.push(`${days}d`)
        } else {
            parts.push(`${days} day${_ending(days)}`)
        }
    }

    /** @type {number} */
    const hours = Math.floor((t %= 86400) / 3600)
    if (hours) {
        if (short) {
            parts.push(`${hours}h`)
        } else {
            parts.push(`${hours} hour${_ending(hours)}`)
        }
    }

    /** @type {number} */
    const minutes = Math.floor((t %= 3600) / 60)
    if (minutes) {
        if (short) {
            parts.push(`${minutes}m`)
        } else {
            parts.push(`${minutes} minute${_ending(minutes)}`)
        }
    }

    /** @type {number} */
    const seconds = t % 60
    if (seconds) {
        if (short) {
            parts.push(`${seconds}s`)
        } else {
            parts.push(`${seconds} second${_ending(seconds)}`)
        }
    }

    if (parts.length === 0) {
        return 'less than a second'
    }

    return parts
        .slice(0, precision)
        .join(short ? ' ' : ' and ')
}

/**
 * Copies the provided text to the clipboard.
 * If the Clipboard API is available, it uses it; otherwise, it falls back to creating a temporary textarea element to copy the text.
 * @global
 * @param {string} text The text to be copied to the clipboard.
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} A promise that resolves to true if the text was successfully copied, or false if it failed.
 */
async function copy_text(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard) {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
        return true
    }

    const $e = create_element(
        'textarea',
        {
            value: text,
            focus: true,
            select: true,
            style: {
                top: '0',
                left: '0',
                position: 'fixed',
            },
        },
        document.body,
    )
    try {
        return document.execCommand('copy')
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('unable to copy', e)
    } finally {
        document.body.removeChild($e)
    }
    return false
}

/**
 * Performs a fetch request to the specified path with the given options, including credentials for authentication.
 * If the response status is 401 (Unauthorized), it opens the login modal.
 * @global
 * @param {string} path The path to which the fetch request is made.
 * @param {Object} [options] The options for the fetch request.
 * @param {Object} [params={}] Additional parameters for handling the fetch response.
 * @param {boolean} [params.noclose=false] Whether to prevent closing the login modal without logging in if a 401 response is received.
 * @returns {Promise<Response | void>} The response from the fetch request.
 */
async function auth_fetch(path, options, { noclose = false } = {}) {
    const r = await fetch(
        `https://${SUB_API}.nopecha.com${path.startsWith('/') ? path : '/' + path}`,
        {
            ...options,
            credentials: 'include',
        },
    )
    if (r.status === 401) {
        open_login_modal({ noclose })
        return
    }
    return r
}

})

    if (!['/pricing', '/manage'].includes(url.pathname)) return
    const paypal_token = url.searchParams.get('token') ?? ''
    const has_paypal_error = url.searchParams.has('errorcode')
    if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{8,32}$/.test(paypal_token) && !has_paypal_error) return
    url.searchParams.delete('token')
    url.searchParams.delete('PayerID')
    url.searchParams.delete('errorcode')
    if (page_authenticated) {
        // PayPal's order token is not an application credential;
        // remove it from history and referrers after a valid return.
        window.history.replaceState({}, '', url)
    } else {
        // The Strict session cookie is intentionally omitted from
        // PayPal's cross-site return request. Once this document is
        // committed, one clean same-site reload sends the cookie
        // and restores authenticated server rendering.
        document.documentElement.style.visibility = 'hidden'
        window.location.replace(url)
    }
})()

    'use strict'

    const get_theme_store = () => localStorage.getItem('theme')

    const set_theme_store = theme => localStorage.setItem('theme', theme)

    const get_theme_pref = () => {
        const theme = get_theme_store()
        if (theme) {
            return theme
        }

        //- return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light'

        //- Default to 'light' if no preference is stored
        return 'light'
    }

    const set_theme = theme => {
        if (theme === 'auto') {
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme', (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light'))
        } else {
            document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bs-theme', theme)
        }

        if (window.refresh_background) {
            window.refresh_background()
        }
    }

    set_theme(get_theme_pref())

    const show_theme_active = (theme, focus = false) => {
        const $switch = document.querySelector('#bd-theme')
        if (!$switch) {
            return
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-theme-value]').forEach($toggle => {
            $toggle.classList.remove('active')
            $toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false')
        })

        const $btn = document.querySelector(`[data-bs-theme-value="${theme}"]`)
        $btn.classList.add('active')
        $btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true')

        document.querySelector('.theme-icon-active use').setAttribute('href', $btn.querySelector('svg use').getAttribute('href'))

        $switch.setAttribute('aria-label', `${document.querySelector('#bd-theme-text').textContent} (${$btn.dataset.bsThemeValue})`)
        if (focus) {
            $switch.focus()
        }
    }

    //- window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', () => {
    //-     if (['light', 'dark'].includes(get_theme_store())) {
    //-         set_theme(get_theme_pref())
    //-     }
    //- })

    //- Update theme on system change only if 'auto' is selected
    window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', () => {
        if (get_theme_store() === 'auto') {
            set_theme(get_theme_pref())
        }
    })

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        show_theme_active(get_theme_pref())

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-bs-theme-value]').forEach($toggle => {
            $toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const theme = $toggle.getAttribute('data-bs-theme-value')
                set_theme_store(theme)
                set_theme(theme)
                show_theme_active(theme, true)
            })
        })
    })

function init_activity_monitor_frame() {
    const $iframe = document.querySelector('#activity_monitor')

    function resize() {
        const vw = $iframe.parentNode.offsetWidth
        const scale = Math.min(1, vw / 1_200)
        $iframe.style.setProperty('--scale', scale)
    }

    resize()
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize)

    function is_visible($e) {
        const style = window.getComputedStyle($e)
        if (style.display === 'none') {
            return false
        }
        if (style.visibility !== 'visible') {
            return false
        }
        if (style.opacity < 0.1) {
            return false
        }

        const {height, width, left, top} = $e.getBoundingClientRect()
        if ($e.offsetWidth + $e.offsetHeight + height + width === 0) {
            return false
        }

        const c = { x: left + $e.offsetWidth / 2, y: top + $e.offsetHeight / 2 }
        if (c.x < 0) {
            return false
        }
        if (c.x > (document.documentElement.clientWidth || window.innerWidth)) {
            return false
        }
        if (c.y < 0) {
            return false
        }
        if (c.y > (document.documentElement.clientHeight || window.innerHeight)) {
            return false
        }

        let $tgt = document.elementFromPoint(c.x, c.y)
        if ($tgt === null) {
            return false
        }

        do {
            if ($tgt === $e) {
                return true
            }
        } while ($tgt = $tgt.parentNode)
        return false
    }

    const demo_visible_interval = setInterval(() => {
        if (is_visible($iframe.parentNode)) {
            clearInterval(demo_visible_interval)
            $iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({ event: 'nopechatvdemo' }, '*')
        }
    }, 1_000)
}

function init_captcha_svgs() {
    const $t = document.querySelector('#template')
    const captcha = {
        funcaptcha: $t.querySelector('.funcaptcha'),
        awscaptcha: $t.querySelector('.awscaptcha'),
        binancecaptcha: $t.querySelector('.binancecaptcha'),
        turnstile: $t.querySelector('.turnstile'),
        geetest: $t.querySelector('.geetest'),
        recaptcha: $t.querySelector('.recaptcha'),
        hcaptcha: $t.querySelector('.hcaptcha'),
        textcaptcha: $t.querySelector('.textcaptcha'),
        perimeterx: $t.querySelector('.perimeterx'),
        lemincaptcha: $t.querySelector('.lemincaptcha'),
    }
    for (const $e of document.querySelectorAll('.captcha_icon')) {
        const c = $e.dataset.captcha
        if (c in captcha) {
            $e.append(captcha[c].cloneNode(true))
        }
    }
    let $captchas = [...Object.values(captcha)]
    for (const $slide of document.querySelectorAll('.slideshow')) {
        $captchas = $captchas.slice().reverse()
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            for (const $e of $captchas) {
                $slide.append($e.cloneNode(true))
            }
        }
    }
}

async function init_analytics() {
    async function fetch_analytics() {
        try {
            return await auth_fetch('/www/analytics').then(r => r.json())
        } catch {
            console.error('failed to fetch analytics data')
        }
        return {}
    }

    function format_number(n) {
        if (n >= 1_000_000_000) {
            return (n / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(0) + 'B'
        }
        if (n >= 1_000_000) {
            return (n / 1_000_000).toFixed(0) + 'M'
        }
        if (n >= 1_000) {
            return (n / 1_000).toFixed(0) + 'K'
        }
        return n.toString()
    }

    const anim_dur = 3_000
    while (true) {
        const r = await fetch_analytics()
        if (r && Object.keys(r).length > 0) {
            window._lastv = window._lastv ?? {}
            for (const $e of document.querySelectorAll('[data-analytics]')) {
                const k = $e.dataset.analytics
                if (!k || !(k in r)) {
                    continue
                }

                $e.querySelector('.loading_wrapper')?.classList?.add('hidden')
                const cb = value => {
                    $e.innerHTML = parseInt(value).toLocaleString('en-US')
                }
                Snap.animate(window._lastv[k] ?? 0, r[k], cb, anim_dur, mina.easeinout)
                window._lastv[k] = r[k]
            }

            //- Calculate human readable nusers (e.g., 1M+)
            const human_readable_nusers = format_number(r.nusers <= 0 ? 1e6 : r.nusers) + '+'
            document.querySelectorAll('.human_readable_nusers').forEach($e => {
                $e.innerHTML = human_readable_nusers
            })
        }
        await sleep(10_000)
    }
}

async function init_salut() {
    let salut, typed, is_auth = "false" === 'true'

    if (is_auth) {
        const hour = (new Date()).getHours()
        if (hour < 12) {

        } else {

        const salut_interval = setInterval(() => {
            try {
                typed.reset()
            } catch {
                clearInterval(salut_interval)
            }
        }, 30_000)
    }

    await sleep(500)
    typed = new Typed('#salut', { strings: ['Hello.', salut], typeSpeed: 30, loop: false })
}
